description: CRIMECAST official vs media-proxy policy for SCRB/NCRB
notes: Any year with data_source in sources_official is usable as a training label (including 2025/2026).
Drop SCRB/NCRB CSVs into dataset/scrb_ncrb/dropin/ as tn_YYYY_*.csv then run: python acquire_scrb_ncrb.py --apply
OpenCity TN tables (2019–2021) are ingested as SCRB-class official history.
